description: Implement a Platt-scaled SVM using a fused kernel: the average of the Tanimoto Morgan kernel and an RBF kernel on standardized physical-chemical descriptors.
Implement a heterogeneous ensemble of Random Forest, LightGBM, Logistic Regression, and SVM with rank-averaged outputs.
Average the predictions of a RandomForest and a LightGBM classifier to reduce variance.
Switch from bit-based Morgan fingerprints to count-based Morgan fingerprints to capture occurrences of chemical environments.
Replace the non-existent DataStructs.GetMorganCountFingerprintAsNumPy with the standard GetMorganFingerprintAsBitVect and convert to a numpy array.
Replace Morgan fingerprints with MACCS structural keys as the molecular featurization method.
Append a set of 11 physchem descriptors (MW, LogP, TPSA, HBD, HBA, RotB, Aromatic, Charge, sp3 fraction, carboxylic acid count, and amine count) to the Morgan fingerprints.
Replace RandomForestClassifier with XGBClassifier using the specified hyperparameters.
Replace RandomForestClassifier with LightGBMClassifier using the specified hyperparameters.
Implement a stacking ensemble using a LogisticRegression meta-learner on out-of-fold probabilities from RandomForest, LightGBM, and LogisticRegression base models.
Concatenate 167-bit MACCS keys with 2048-bit Morgan fingerprints to provide both structural and environment-based features.
Fix the featurize function by removing the non-existent MACCS key call and simplifying the feature extraction to use only Morgan fingerprints.
Replace LightGBM with a RandomForestClassifier using 1000 trees, 'sqrt' max features, and min_samples_leaf=2 to increase model capacity and reduce variance.
Implement a Tanimoto-kernel SVM using precomputed similarity matrices of Morgan fingerprints.
Concatenate RDKit 2D descriptors with Morgan fingerprints as input features.
Concatenate RDKit 2D descriptors with Morgan fingerprints as input features.
Implement a bootstrap-bagged LightGBM ensemble by averaging predictions from 5 models with different seeds and row subsampling.
Limit the complexity of the LightGBM model by setting max_depth and increasing the minimum child samples to improve generalization on unseen scaffolds.
Implement multi-radius Morgan count fingerprints (radii 1, 2, and 3) with pharmacophoric feature invariants and concatenate them into a single feature vector.
Implement multi-radius Morgan count fingerprints (radii 1, 2, and 3) with pharmacophoric feature invariants and concatenate them into a single feature vector.
Implement a multi-view ensemble of LightGBM models using Morgan fingerprints at radii 1, 2, and 3, averaging the predicted probabilities.
Replace LightGBM with CatBoostClassifier and enhance features by concatenating Morgan fingerprints with basic physical properties.
Replace LightGBM with CatBoostClassifier and enhance features by concatenating Morgan fingerprints with basic physical properties.
Add pharmacophore-related SMARTS patterns as additional binary features to improve blood-brain barrier penetration prediction.
Switch from CatBoostClassifier to LightGBMClassifier with DART boosting to provide strong regularization through random tree dropping.
Add atom-pair count and topological torsion count fingerprints to the molecular features before training.
Implement transductive self-training by using the top and bottom 15% of test predictions as pseudo-labels for a second training pass.
Replace CatBoostClassifier with XGBClassifier using the specified hyperparameters.
Implement a pairwise linear model on fingerprint differences to optimize ranking, and average its results with the CatBoost model to improve AUROC.
Implement a k-Nearest Neighbors (k=10) predictor using Tanimoto similarity on Morgan fingerprints as a standalone model.
Implement a LogisticRegression model with a tuned L2 penalty and standardized inputs to capture linear dependencies in Morgan fingerprints.
Implement a rank-blended ensemble using CatBoost and Bernoulli Naive Bayes to introduce diversity and smooth the predictions.
Implement a rank-blended ensemble using CatBoost and Bernoulli Naive Bayes to introduce diversity and smooth the predictions.
Apply monotone constraints to the CatBoost model, specifically enforcing a negative relationship for the TPSA descriptor while keeping others neutral.
Append 32 components from a TruncatedSVD fit on the combined Morgan fingerprints of training and testing sets to the existing features before training the CatBoost model.
Neutralize molecules to the parent form before featurization and include the original formal charge as an additional feature.
Fix the AttributeError by correcting the method name from GetNetAtomischarge to GetTotalNetCharge or using a more standard RDKit approach.
Implement an inner grouped-CV to select the best num_leaves for the CatBoost model using Murcko scaffolds as groups.
Implement inverse scaffold-frequency sample weighting to prevent large scaffold families from dominating the training process, improving generalization to unseen skeletons.
Filter out Morgan fingerprint bits that are either too frequent (>= 95%) or too rare (< 5%) in the training set to reduce noise.
Remove training molecules that have a near-duplicate (Tanimoto similarity >= 0.9) with a different label to reduce label noise.
